steps: Open Wells Fargo's official page https://creditcards.wellsfargo.com/no-annual-fee-credit-cards/ and confirm the Signify Business Cash $500-after-$5,000 offer is still showing.
Complete the business application (sole proprietorships are eligible); Wells Fargo runs a hard inquiry when you apply.
If approved, spend $5,000 on business purchases you were already planning within the first 3 months.
Pay the balance in full — after the 12-month 0% intro, the variable APR (16.74%–24.74%) destroys the bonus.
The $500 cash rewards bonus is yours; keep the card free long-term with its unlimited 2% business earning.
